props.name: entity
props.meaning: Type, id and optional name, as an entity field returns it.

props.name: variant
props.meaning: Boxed chip, inline link, or the bare name.

props.name: href
props.default: the row's page on the site

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the row's own page lives on.

props.name: preview
props.meaning: Field paths shown in a hover card. Needs a context.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context, for the site url and for the hover card's read.

props.name: client
props.meaning: A client, for an app with no context. One context is built per client and shared.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Heights 5, 6, 8 and 10 for the chip; the type scale for the others.

props.name: remove_label
props.meaning: Accessible name for the remove control.

events.name: clicked
events.when: The content was pressed. It renders as a button. Ignored when a link is set. Svelte spells it `onclick`, as it does every DOM event.

keyboard.does: Moves to the link or button, then to the remove control.
Follows the link, or activates the button.
Activates the button or the remove control.
